remarks: Bright and Spacious 2-Bed, 1.5-Bath end unit Townhouse in Prime Location! Perfectly situated for commuters-just minutes to South Norwalk Station, I-95, Route 7, and the Merritt Parkway. This well-maintained townhouse offers the best of convenience and comfort with shops, grocery stores, and restaurants right around the corner. Enjoy hardwood floors, in-unit laundry, central air, and an attached garage. With generous living space and a versatile layout, you'll have room to relax, entertain, and make yourself at home. Don't miss your chance to live close to everything Norwalk has to offer!
